verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented way to plug external MCP servers into Inngest or AgentKit so their tools can be consumed. The only MCP evidence is the reverse role: Inngest's own MCP server, which lets coding agents connect to Inngest. AgentKit's generic 'agents that use tools' claim never mentions MCP client support, and an agent framework could plausibly ship it, so the axis applies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
